findings.function: flashLoan, joinPool, exitPool, uniswapV3Swap, claim (Merkl), exactInput, deposit (DvStETH), send (OFT), call(address,address,uint256,bytes) (9 functions)
findings.source: BalancerV2DecoderAndSanitizer.sol:24-27 addressesFound = abi.encodePacked(recipient); for (uint256 i; i < tokens.length; ++i) addressesFound = abi.encodePacked(addressesFound, tokens[i]);
findings.issue: Inside the loop _9 and _14 are both the current mem[64] (no store to mem[64] in between), but they are not identified with it, so the new length prints as '_9 + _10 - mem[64] + 20' instead of '_10 + 20', and the final 'return addressesFound' as a memory range whose length contains mem[64]. With the inner copy loop (P7) and a zero store overwritten on the next line, the abi.encodePacked accumulation becomes unreadable.
findings.rule: After '_t = mem[64]', mem[64] reads as _t until the next store to mem[64] (here _9 + _10 - _9 + 20 = _10 + 20); a store followed by a store to the same address with no read between is dead; then 'mem[p] = 32; mem[p + 32 ...] = bytes(b); return memory from p' is 'return b'.

notes: All 150 ABI functions reviewed (5 are const lines returning empty bytes; the ~120 one-line decoders that return abi.encodePacked of their address arguments read and spot-checked; execute (UniversalRouter), modifyLiquidities (626 lines, UniswapV4), swapCompact, lockdown by structure). The 8 source loops are all whiles: flashLoan (1486), joinPool (1586), exitPool (1536), Merkl claim (1690), OFT send's options cursor loop (2076), OneInch uniswapV3Swap (1171), UniswapV3 exactInput's hop loop (1734, condition 'idx < path.length / 23'), DvStETH deposit (1803). The other whiles are implicit: 33 memory copies (the abi.encodePacked accumulation nested in each source loop, bytes encodings, P7) and 10 validated ABI decodes. No semantic difference found.
summary: Faithful, and every loop is found; the abi.encodePacked accumulation in the loops is obscured by a free-memory-pointer temporary that is not identified with mem[64] and by nested copy whiles.
